steps.en: Due driver notices at the final letter stage are picked for the next step
steps.id: Notice driver yang jatuh tempo di tahap surat terakhir dipilih untuk langkah berikutnya
steps.why_en: Selection uses only date and suspension status, not the court conditions the story names.
steps.why_id: Pemilihan hanya memakai tanggal dan status suspension, bukan kondisi court yang disebut story.

steps.en: The court conditions are assessed to decide whether to charge the driver
steps.id: Kondisi court dinilai untuk memutuskan apakah driver di-charge
steps.why_en: No rule or check for these court conditions exists in the system.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada aturan atau pengecekan untuk kondisi court ini di sistem.

steps.en: After the final letter, the notice is scheduled for the court stage
steps.id: Setelah surat terakhir, notice dijadwalkan ke tahap court
steps.why_en: Only the next stage and date are set, and the letter run only works through a manual trigger in production.
steps.why_id: Yang diisi hanya tahap dan tanggal berikutnya, dan proses surat di produksi hanya jalan lewat trigger manual.

steps.en: The notice moves into the court stage automatically
steps.id: Notice pindah ke tahap court secara otomatis
steps.why_en: The move to the court stage is done by staff manually or by another system, not automatically.
steps.why_id: Perpindahan ke tahap court dilakukan staff secara manual atau oleh sistem lain, bukan otomatis.
